|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Precision Targeting (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Precision Targeting (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The original slip and the [[:File:Dagobah-D-precisiontargeting-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher base card]] have no title dot. The remastered slip prints a dot. The period rule ordinarily retains the restriction of the underlying card. The later single weapon pull names your deploy phase, where the general deployment and One Rule rules govern the action. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 Period One Rule].
